mechanism.en: Models emit bracketed or Mustache template slots (`[insert ...]`, `{{var}}`, `【待补充】`) when source facts are missing.
mechanism.zh: 缺少事实时模型会顺手输出括号或双花括号占位槽（如 `[insert ...]`、`{{var}}`、`【待补充】`），漏改即成硬伤。

falsePositiveGuards: Code blocks, inline code, and URLs are masked in `prose`.
Numeric array subscripts (`items[0]`) and standard section numbers do not match.

exemplar.bad: Q3 settlement ran across 14 gateways; p95 latency was [insert p95 latency].
exemplar.trap: Q3 settlement improved dramatically across 14 gateways.
exemplar.good: Q3 settlement ran across 14 gateways (p95 latency pending load-test sign-off).

name.zh: 对话寒暄壳与检索残迹

mechanism.en: Copy-pasting model responses leaves assistant greetings, sign-offs, or internal citation tokens (`[oaicite:...]`, `【4†source】`, `utm_source=chatgpt.com`).
mechanism.zh: 直接粘贴模型输出时残留“好的，以下是……”“希望这对你有帮助”或内部检索引用标记。

falsePositiveGuards: Plain document intros like `以下是本周进展：` without conversational lead-ins (`好的`/`当然可以`) stay exempt.
Natural idioms like `Sure enough` stay exempt.

exemplar.bad: Certainly! Here is the revised rollout note: Cluster B migrates on November 24 at 02:00 UTC.
exemplar.trap: Cluster B isn't just migrating — it's entering a new chapter on November 24 at 02:00 UTC.
exemplar.good: Cluster B migrates on November 24 at 02:00 UTC.

name.en: Unrendered Markdown Syntax in Office Documents
name.zh: Office 文档裸露 Markdown 符号

mechanism.en: LLM markdown output pasted into DOCX/PPTX preserves literal `**bold**` asterisks or `## ` headings inside OOXML text runs.
mechanism.zh: 将大模型生成的 Markdown 直接贴进 Word/PPT，导致 `**加粗**` 或 `## 标题` 原样暴露在正文里。

falsePositiveGuards: Evaluated only inside extracted DOCX `<w:t>` and PPTX `<a:t>` text runs, excluding deleted revisions `<w:del>`.

exemplar.bad: **Key Milestone**: Ship v0.2 parser before Friday.
exemplar.trap: Key Milestone — a game-changing v0.2 parser ships Friday.
exemplar.good: Key Milestone: Ship v0.2 parser before Friday.

mechanism.en: Generated HTML mockups routinely leave `href="#"`, `javascript:void(0)`, empty buttons, or unexplained static `disabled` buttons.
mechanism.zh: AI 生成的界面原型常留下 `href="#"`、`javascript:void(0)`、无标签空按钮或未解释原因的禁用按钮。

falsePositiveGuards: Real fragment anchors (`href="#pricing"`), click-handled anchors (`onClick`/`hx-get`), and disabled buttons with `title` or `aria-describedby` are exempt.
